purpose: A bounded diagnostic ordinary-shooter baseline; not a promised playable model or a Genie reproduction.

data.augmentation: none in the first baseline; preserve palette and geometry
data.validation: fixed source-stratified blocks plus separately reported targeted coverage stress cases
data.reserved_test: exclude from development sampling, tuning and pilot evaluation
data.joining: only checked adjacent blocks within frozen sequences.json; never bridge a gap
data.training_inputs: Verified 128px NPZ clips from the bound v9 cohort, using checked sequences only

stages.name: feasibility
stages.promotion: validated ingestion, resume, evaluation and measured GPU throughput/memory

stages.name: actions
stages.promotion: G2 predictive use plus semantic interventions; occupancy alone is insufficient

stages.name: dynamics
stages.promotion: G3 held-out prediction and closed-loop rollout criteria

optimization.mixed_precision: FP16 with conservative initial scaling; requires a new GPU precision and resume measurement for changed code
optimization.schedule: 500-update linear warmup then cosine decay to 10% of stage peak; persist schedule and scaler in checkpoints
optimization.fallback: reduce microbatch and raise accumulation first; do not silently reduce resolution, change architecture or enlarge budget

action_interpretation.intended_capacity: 9 x 8 x 2 combinations; code counts express a hypothesis, not learned movement/aim/fire semantics
action_interpretation.motion_warp: disabled because prior warp diagnostics produced similar smoothing shifts; correlation objectives deferred to a controlled later ablation

gates.nature: Provisional engineering acceptance targets to implement before training, not established scientific sufficiency thresholds.

G1.insufficient_examples_result: unmeasured, not pass; rare large pentagons reported separately

G2.semantics: Train-calibrated movement sign, aim direction and emission toggle must transfer. Hold other codes fixed; report leakage into untargeted behaviors. Do not substitute future-inferred reconstruction for commanded control.
G2.independence_tolerances: Matched one-second rollouts: aim-only changes >=30 degrees while scene displacement differs by <=2px; fire-toggle changes >=2 attributable projectile births while aim differs <=15 degrees and scene displacement <=2px; movement changes scene displacement >=4px while aim differs <=15 degrees and firing mode is preserved. Report failures and ambiguous cases. These are interface effects, not recovered human inputs.

G3.success_definition: Persistent visible player and barrel; coherent local scene rather than blanking/repetition; continuous trajectories and stable wall geometry; repeatable commanded effects. Zero unambiguous wall crossings on wall cases. Record a rubric per rollout before scoring.
G3.target_inferred_actions: May be reported separately as an oracle diagnostic, never as playable control or the primary closed-loop score.

required_before_execution: Local real-data preflight must pass for this code/configuration.
Before GPU allocation: explicit authorization, live rate/balance and measured FP16/memory/throughput pilot.
Before later stages: scored G1/G2 promotion evidence bound to the exact prior checkpoint; missing measurements are not passes.

continuation.same_architecture: branch from best checkpoint; keep original checkpoint; train on curated old+new mixture; deduplicate new sources against every split
continuation.new_data_initial_mix: retain 50% old-data sampling mass initially; cap new-data mass at 50%; revise from validation results and new-data size, not an automatic permanent rule
continuation.fixed_evaluation: keep original validation and reserved test assignments; add new challenge sets separately
continuation.tokenizer_or_action_change: version the representation; re-encode/relabel and adapt or retrain dependent dynamics; do not assume token/code IDs preserve meaning
continuation.collapsed_action_model: do not automatically spend remaining budget resuming a collapsed checkpoint; compare a fresh action initialization and objective changes under a separate bounded plan
